name: 股指弱收盘20日逆波动率多头
sample: 规则在 IF/IH/IC 2015-04-16 至 2021-12-31 研究期上固定。样本外数据单独放在 oos/，覆盖 2022-01-01 至 2025-12-31，尚未回测。不读 2026。动态分配在样本外只使用样本外观测。

parameters.allocation_rule: inverse sample standard deviation of each symbol's trailing 20 close-to-close returns; normalize to sum 3; cap each multiplier at 2 and redistribute excess proportionally
parameters.warmup_rule: equal multipliers until 20-session estimate is available; OOS warmup uses OOS observations only

chosen.allocation_rule: inverse sample standard deviation of each symbol's trailing 20 close-to-close returns; normalize to sum 3; cap each multiplier at 2 and redistribute excess proportionally
chosen.warmup_rule: equal multipliers until 20-session estimate is available; OOS warmup uses OOS observations only

costs: 初始资金1000万元；历史手续费；开盘腿使用连续交易前30分钟L1报价，旧合约换月平仓一跳；逐日中金所开仓限额、整数手；10%回撤熔断并停10个交易日。
limitations: 固定的 CLV、冲高与波动缩放沿用既有规则。动态分配是独立策略。样本外尚未回测。不读 2026。
